Kaise apply karein — 5 Steps

Simple steps, sahi order mein. Pehle drama, phir pitch — is order ko mat todo.

  1. 1

    Drama live karo

    Pehle apna drama upload karo — channel par drama live hona chahiye. Bina live drama ke pitch ka koi matlab nahi.

  2. 2

    Business email banao — MANDATORY hai

    Personal Gmail se companies serious nahi leti. Apne channel ya business ke naam par business email banao, aur usi se apply karo.

  3. 3

    Channel details ready rakho

    Channel name, subscribers, channel URL aur monthly views — ye sab pehle se ready rakho, taaki pitch bharte waqt rukna na pade.

  4. 4

    Company chuno + pitch banao

    Neeche di gayi list se company chuno, phir ready-made pitch copy karo ya Asli Kamai AI se apne hisaab se pitch banao.

  5. 5

    Business email se bhejo + follow-up karo

    Pitch apne business email se bhejo. 7 din mein jawab na aaye to ek polite follow-up mail bhejo — baar-baar mail mat karo.

Acceptance ki koi guarantee nahi hoti — company khud decide karti hai. Sahi details aur professional pitch se tumhara chance behtar hota hai.

Ready-Made Pitch — Copy & Send

Ek professional pitch, har company ke liye. Brackets [ ] mein apni details bharo, company chuno, aur apne business email se bhejo.

Universal pitch template 
Subject: Short Drama Licensing Enquiry — YouTube ([Territory]) — [Channel Name]

Dear [Company Name] Licensing Team,

I am [Your Name], owner of the YouTube channel [Channel Name] ([Channel URL], [Subscribers] subscribers). We publish localised short dramas for the Indian audience, and I am writing to enquire about licensing your short drama titles for distribution on YouTube.

What we are looking for:
- Territory: [Territory]
- Platform: YouTube
- Language: Hindi dubbing / subtitles (please confirm availability)
- Titles: your licensed short drama catalogue for the above territory and platform

About our channel:
- Channel: [Channel Name] — [Channel URL]
- Subscribers: [Subscribers]
- Top dramas: [Top drama links]
- We publish regularly and can share our best-performing episodes on request.

Could you please share the titles available for [Territory] / YouTube, your licensing model (flat fee / revenue share), term and the next steps?

Regards,
[Your Name]
[Business Email]

Kaise use karein: 1. Brackets mein apni details bharo. 2. Upar wali list se company chuno. 3. Apne business email se bhejo. Koi bhi company acceptance ki guarantee nahi deti — decision unka hota hai.
